The '''cloudcraft''' was a small space [[Transport/Legends|transport]].

[[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Bisad Koong]] of [[Roon/Legends|Roon's]] [[Tawntoom]] province owned a cloudcraft during the early years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]], the vessel came into the possession of [[Mungo Baobab]], who used it while searching Roon for the source of the [[Roonstone]]s.
